notes: Locked baseline for Benchmark A. Pinned seed=42 and pinned SQLite 3.51.1 via pysqlite3-binary==0.5.4.post2 (run.py routes the sqlite3 module through it). SQLite is pinned because FTS5 BM25 ranking shifts across SQLite versions: this corpus yields nDCG@5 of 0.8657 / 0.8934 / 0.9111 under SQLite 3.46 / 3.50 / 3.51, a spread wider than the 0.02 regression threshold, so an unpinned baseline drifts whenever a CI runner image bumps its bundled SQLite. Re-locked 2026-05-29 against the pinned build (was 0.8934 under an older runner SQLite; the retrieval algorithm is unchanged). The pipeline_rrf_fts5_plus_bow ndcg_at_5 is the primary headline; recall_at_10 and negative_probe_all_passed are also enforced by regression_guard.py. The bag-of-words backend is a synthetic surrogate for the roadmap dense leg.

negative_probe.criterion: FTS5 must return <= 0 hits for every out-of-vocabulary query
